$comment: Curated identity and level table. This is the single source of truth for
which ADM level is the MUNICIPAL tier in each country, and it cannot be
inferred from the data: geoBoundaries' level numbers are not semantically
consistent across countries. A Chilean comuna is ADM3; a Mexican municipio
is ADM2; a US county is ADM2. See docs/reference/admin-levels.md.
municipal_level: null means no municipal tier is published for that
verify: true marks an entry whose level assignment or unit count has not
yet been checked against an official source. Those ship with
Populated for the Americas, Europe and Africa (UN M49, plus Kosovo as XKX).

BHS.note: geoBoundaries ADM1 (32) and ADM2 (34) are near-identical; likely a duplicated tier.

GLP.note: geoBoundaries publishes ADM4 only — no ADM1/2/3. Level skip.

JAM.note: geoBoundaries ADM2 reports 827 units against 14 parishes; almost certainly mis-tiered electoral divisions.

MTQ.note: geoBoundaries publishes ADM3 and ADM4 only. Level skip.

PRI.note: geoBoundaries has no ADM0 or ADM1 for Puerto Rico; ADM0 comes from Natural Earth.

LCA.note: geoBoundaries ADM2 reports 547 units against 10 quarters; likely mis-tiered.

VIR.note: geoBoundaries publishes ADM3 only. Level skip.

FLK.note: Sovereignty disputed between the United Kingdom and Argentina. Geometry follows the named source; see about/disputed-boundaries.md.

GUF.note: geoBoundaries ADM3 reports 2 units against 22 communes. Level skip and likely incomplete.

PER.note: geoBoundaries publishes ADM2 (196 provinces) but no ADM3; Peru's municipal tier is the district and is unavailable.

name.en: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands
name.es: Georgias del Sur y Sandwich del Sur

SGS.note: Sovereignty disputed between the United Kingdom and Argentina.

ALA.note: Autonomous region of Finland. Natural Earth draws it as its own unit; geoBoundaries has no Åland dataset.

EST.note: geoBoundaries' subdivisions for Estonia are copyleft (ODbL or CC-BY-SA, from OpenStreetMap); only the Natural Earth outline is published.

FRO.note: Self-governing territory of Denmark; geoBoundaries publishes ADM0 only.

FIN.note: geoBoundaries' subdivisions for Finland are copyleft (ODbL or CC-BY-SA, from OpenStreetMap); only the Natural Earth outline is published.

GGY.note: British Crown dependency; geoBoundaries publishes ADM0 only.

ISL.note: ADM1 is ODbL and not published, so the municipalities (74, a 2016 vintage; 64 today) have no ADM1 above them.

IRL.note: geoBoundaries' ADM2 has 166 units, matching the 2019 local electoral areas rather than the 31 local authorities.

IMN.note: British Crown dependency; geoBoundaries publishes ADM0 only.

JEY.note: British Crown dependency; geoBoundaries has no Jersey dataset.

LVA.note: The 43 municipalities (36 districts and 7 state cities) of the 2021 reform are the first-level units.

LTU.note: geoBoundaries' counties and municipalities are copyleft (ODbL or CC-BY-SA, from OpenStreetMap); only the Natural Earth outline is published.

NOR.note: Municipalities are a 2013 vintage (431, before the 2020 reform) and counties 2022 (11). Natural Earth's outline includes Svalbard, Jan Mayen and Bouvet Island.

SJM.note: Natural Earth includes Svalbard and Jan Mayen in Norway's outline, so nothing is published under SJM.

GBR.note: ADM2 has 216 units from the Office for National Statistics (2019), the upper-tier counties and unitary authorities.

AUT.note: geoBoundaries' subdivisions for Austria are copyleft (ODbL or CC-BY-SA, from OpenStreetMap); only the Natural Earth outline is published.

BEL.note: Municipalities are a 2018 vintage (589, before the 2019 mergers that left 581).

FRA.note: Communes (2020) are ODC-By. The 129 communes of the five overseas departments have no parent among the 13 metropolitan regions and are in ADM5/unassigned.geojson; Guadeloupe, Martinique, French Guiana, Réunion and Mayotte also publish theirs as territories of their own. Natural Earth's outline includes the overseas regions.

DEU.note: Municipalities (Gemeinden) are not in geoBoundaries; the published tier is the districts (Kreise and kreisfreie Städte). Coastal and lakeside districts come upstream as a land and a water polygon; they are merged into one feature.

LIE.note: geoBoundaries' subdivisions for Liechtenstein are copyleft (ODbL or CC-BY-SA, from OpenStreetMap); only the Natural Earth outline is published.

LUX.note: Cantons (ADM1) are ODbL and not published; the communes are geoBoundaries' ADM3 (102, 2018).

MCO.note: geoBoundaries' subdivisions for Monaco are copyleft (ODbL or CC-BY-SA, from OpenStreetMap); only the Natural Earth outline is published.

NLD.note: Natural Earth's outline includes the Caribbean Netherlands (Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba).

CHE.note: geoBoundaries' Swiss subdivisions come from swisstopo under its own licence, which is not on the allow-list; only the Natural Earth outline is published.

ALB.note: The 61 municipalities of the 2015 reform are not in geoBoundaries; only the counties are published.

HRV.note: geoBoundaries' subdivisions for Croatia are copyleft (ODbL or CC-BY-SA, from OpenStreetMap); only the Natural Earth outline is published.

GIB.note: British Overseas Territory claimed by Spain; the outline follows Natural Earth.

GRC.note: Mount Athos, autonomous, appears at every level.

ITA.note: geoBoundaries' ADM1 is the five NUTS 1 macro-regions; the 20 regions (ADM2) and 107 provinces (ADM3) exist upstream but are not built by this pipeline yet.

MNE.note: geoBoundaries' subdivisions for Montenegro are copyleft (ODbL or CC-BY-SA, from OpenStreetMap); only the Natural Earth outline is published.

PRT.note: Districts (ADM1) are ODbL and not published, so the municipalities (311 units against 308 concelhos) have no ADM1 above them.

SMR.note: geoBoundaries' subdivisions for San Marino are copyleft (ODbL or CC-BY-SA, from OpenStreetMap); only the Natural Earth outline is published.

SRB.note: geoBoundaries' subdivisions for Serbia are copyleft (ODbL or CC-BY-SA, from OpenStreetMap); only the Natural Earth outline is published. Natural Earth draws Kosovo separately; see XKX.

SVN.note: Municipalities are ODbL and not published; the two cohesion regions are.

ESP.note: Provinces (ADM2) come under INE's own licence, not on the allow-list, so municipalities sit directly under the autonomous communities, Ceuta and Melilla.

XKX.note: XKX is a user-assigned code, not ISO 3166-1. Kosovo declared independence from Serbia in 2008; Serbia and a number of states do not recognise it. The outline follows Natural Earth, which draws Kosovo separately. geoBoundaries' subdivisions are copyleft (CC-BY-SA, from OpenStreetMap) and not published.

CZE.note: Municipalities are ODbL (OpenStreetMap) and not published; regions are.

HUN.note: Settlements are ODbL (OpenStreetMap) and not published. The first level is the 19 counties: geoBoundaries draws Budapest inside Pest county rather than as a unit of its own, although its metadata counts 20.

POL.note: geoBoundaries' subdivisions for Poland are copyleft (ODbL or CC-BY-SA, from OpenStreetMap); only the Natural Earth outline is published.

MDA.note: The first level mixes districts, municipalities and the autonomous territorial units; communes are not in geoBoundaries.

ROU.note: ADM2 has 3,235 units against 3,181 administrative-territorial units.

RUS.note: geoBoundaries' subdivisions are copyleft (ODbL or CC-BY-SA, from OpenStreetMap); only the Natural Earth outline is published. Natural Earth draws Crimea inside Russia's outline; Ukraine and most states consider it Ukrainian territory. The outline crosses the antimeridian.

SVK.note: geoBoundaries' subdivisions for Slovakia are copyleft (ODbL or CC-BY-SA, from OpenStreetMap); only the Natural Earth outline is published.

UKR.note: Oblasts are ODbL and not published; the raions are a 2006 vintage, before the 2020 reform. Natural Earth draws Crimea inside Russia's outline, not Ukraine's; geoBoundaries' raions include Crimea.

DZA.note: geoBoundaries' subdivisions for Algeria are copyleft (CC-BY-SA and ODbL); only the Natural Earth outline is published.

EGY.note: Governorates (ADM1) are copyleft (ODbL) and not published, so the districts have no ADM1 above them. Natural Earth draws the Halaib Triangle, claimed by Sudan, inside Egypt's outline.

LBY.note: The 22 districts (shabiyat) are the first level; municipalities are not in geoBoundaries.

MAR.note: geoBoundaries' subdivisions for Morocco are copyleft (ODbL); only the Natural Earth outline is published. Natural Earth's default view draws the part of Western Sahara west of the Moroccan berm inside Morocco's outline; the UN lists Western Sahara as a non-self-governing territory, and its sovereignty is disputed between Morocco and the Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic. See ESH.

SDN.note: The first level is the 18 states plus the Abyei Area, which has no ISO 3166-2 code. Natural Earth draws Abyei and Kafia Kingi, both claimed by South Sudan, inside Sudan's outline, and the Halaib Triangle inside Egypt's.

TUN.note: geoBoundaries' subdivisions for Tunisia are copyleft (ODbL); only the Natural Earth outline is published.

ESH.note: A non-self-governing territory on the UN list; sovereignty is disputed between Morocco and the Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic. The outline follows Natural Earth's default view, which covers only the area east of the Moroccan berm; the area west of it is inside Morocco's outline. geoBoundaries has no Western Sahara dataset.

IOT.note: The Chagos Archipelago, administered by the United Kingdom and claimed by Mauritius; the two signed a treaty in 2025 to transfer sovereignty. The outline follows Natural Earth. geoBoundaries has no dataset for it.

BDI.note: Provinces (18) and communes (119) predate the 2025 reform, which left 5 provinces and 42 communes.

COM.note: The islands (ADM1) are copyleft (ODbL) and not published, so the communes have no ADM1 above them. Comoros claims Mayotte (MYT).

ERI.note: Regions (ADM1) are copyleft (ODbL) and not published, so the subregions have no ADM1 above them. Natural Earth draws Badme, awarded to Eritrea in 2002, inside Eritrea's outline.

ETH.note: Zones and woredas are copyleft (ODbL) and not published; the regions are, in a vintage that predates the 2020–2023 creation of new regions.

ATF.note: Natural Earth's outline includes the Scattered Islands in the Indian Ocean (Glorioso, Juan de Nova, Bassas da India, Europa, Tromelin), claimed variously by Madagascar, Comoros and Mauritius. geoBoundaries has no dataset for it.

KEN.note: The 47 counties are the devolved local governments. Natural Earth draws the Ilemi Triangle, claimed by South Sudan, inside Kenya's outline.

MDG.note: Regions (ADM1) are copyleft (ODbL) and not published, so the communes have no ADM1 above them. Madagascar claims the Scattered Islands (see ATF).

MWI.note: Regions (ADM1) are copyleft (ODbL) and not published, so the districts have no ADM1 above them.

MUS.note: geoBoundaries' districts are copyleft (ODbL); only the Natural Earth outline is published. Mauritius claims the Chagos Archipelago (see IOT) and Tromelin (see ATF).

MYT.note: A French overseas department, claimed by Comoros. Natural Earth draws it inside France's outline, so no ADM0 is published; geoBoundaries publishes the communes (ADM4) only. The same communes are in FRA ADM5.

MOZ.note: Provinces (ADM1) are copyleft (ODbL) and not published, so the districts have no ADM1 above them.

REU.note: A French overseas department. Natural Earth draws it inside France's outline, so no ADM0 is published; geoBoundaries has its arrondissements (ADM3) and communes (ADM4), and the communes are published. The same communes are in FRA ADM5.

RWA.note: Sectors, cells and villages (ADM3–ADM5) are below the municipal tier and not built.

SYC.note: geoBoundaries' ADM1 is copyleft (CC-BY-SA); its ADM3 holds the districts and is published without an ADM1 above it.

SOM.note: The outline is Natural Earth's Somalia and Somaliland dissolved into one, matching ISO 3166's single entry and geoBoundaries' districts. Somaliland declared independence in 1991 and functions de facto as a separate state, recognised by few or no others. Regions (ADM1) are copyleft and not published.

SSD.note: South Sudan claims Abyei, Kafia Kingi and the Ilemi Triangle, which Natural Earth draws inside Sudan and Kenya.

UGA.note: Regions (ADM1) are copyleft (ODbL) and not published, so the districts have no ADM1 above them.

TZA.note: Regions (ADM1) are copyleft (ODbL) and not published, so the districts have no ADM1 above them.

AGO.note: Provinces (18) and municipalities predate the 2024 reform, which created 21 provinces and 326 municipalities.

CMR.note: Communes are copyleft (ODbL) and not published; the regions are.

CAF.note: Prefectures predate the 2020 reform that brought them to 20.

TCD.note: Provinces (ADM1) are copyleft (ODbL) and not published, so the departments have no ADM1 above them.

COG.note: Departments (ADM1) are copyleft (ODbL) and not published, so the districts have no ADM1 above them.

COD.note: Provinces (ADM1) are copyleft (ODbL) and not published, so the territories have no ADM1 above them.

GNQ.note: Provinces (ADM1) are copyleft (ODbL) and not published, so the ADM2 units have no ADM1 above them.

GAB.note: Provinces (ADM1) are copyleft (CC-BY-SA) and not published, so the departments have no ADM1 above them.

STP.note: geoBoundaries' subdivisions for São Tomé and Príncipe are copyleft (ODbL); only the Natural Earth outline is published.

BWA.note: Districts (ADM1) are copyleft (CC-BY-SA) and not published, so the sub-districts have no ADM1 above them.

SWZ.note: geoBoundaries' subdivisions for Eswatini are copyleft (ODbL); only the Natural Earth outline is published.

LSO.note: Districts (ADM1) are copyleft (ODbL) and not published, so the ADM2 units have no ADM1 above them.

NAM.note: The regions are a pre-2013 vintage: 13 units, with Kavango not yet split into Kavango East and West, and Caprivi under its former name (Zambezi since 2013). geoBoundaries' constituencies (ADM2, 2007) are left out: seven carry the name 'Luderitz' although only one is in Lüderitz, and six overlap no region.

ZAF.note: ADM2 holds the 52 district and metropolitan municipalities; ADM3 the local and metropolitan municipalities. Wards (ADM4) are not built.

BFA.note: Regions (13) predate the 2025 reform, which created 17.

CPV.note: geoBoundaries' municipalities are copyleft (ODbL); only the Natural Earth outline is published.

GHA.note: Regions (ADM1) are copyleft (CC-BY-SA) and not published, so the districts have no ADM1 above them.

GNB.note: geoBoundaries' subdivisions for Guinea-Bissau are copyleft (ODbL); only the Natural Earth outline is published.

MLI.note: Regions (9) predate the 2023 reform that created 19.

MRT.note: Regions (ADM1) are copyleft (CC-BY-SA) and not published, so the departments have no ADM1 above them.

NER.note: Regions (ADM1) are copyleft (ODbL) and not published, so the communes have no ADM1 above them.

name.en: Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha
name.es: Santa Elena, Ascensión y Tristán de Acuña

SHN.note: British Overseas Territory; geoBoundaries publishes ADM0 only.

SLE.note: Provinces (4) and districts (14) predate the 2017 reform that created a fifth province and 16 districts.

TGO.note: geoBoundaries' subdivisions for Togo are copyleft (CC-BY-SA and ODbL); only the Natural Earth outline is published.
